## About
Ed's Transmission Northgate sits at 1201 N Northgate Way in Seattle. Chuck runs the shop, and you'll usually find him and Dan at the front desk, ready to talk you through what's going on with your car.
Reviewers describe the place as old school, honest and fairly priced. A couple of customers came to us after other shops wouldn't touch their transmission, and we were glad to take the work on.
We're open Monday through Thursday. Get in touch with Chuck and we'll figure out the next step together.

## Services
- Transmissions: One longtime customer has brought Chuck over 20 transmissions.
- Transmission fluid leak: One reviewer brought us a fluid leak after another shop turned him away.
- Used transmission: When parts were hard to get, Chuck tracked down a used transmission for one customer.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Thursday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Another shop wouldn't take my transmission. Will you look at it?
A: Get in touch. One reviewer came to us after being turned away at another shop, and we took the job on.

Q: Can I email Chuck?
A: Yes. Reach Chuck at chuck@edstransmissionnorthgate.com.
